verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Kintsugi is built around US-style sales tax concepts (nexus, registrations, filings, tax estimate), with no mention of VAT/tax-ID validation against official registries (e.g., VIES) or reverse-charge mechanics for B2B cross-border sales. Since a tax-compliance API could plausibly support VAT/reverse charge, this axis applies, but there is no evidence it is delivered.
